text:
laura_pm: quick check — can we confirm owners and blockers for the trace ingestion + UI slices milestone? planning to cut the retention and hook tasks into separate rollouts this week.
samir_eng: I can own the ingestion side (backfill + streaming). Need final schema from observability to avoid index churn.
jia_obs: I’ll own the dashboard + example queries. sending schema now — attaching gist: https://gist.github.com/jia/trace-schema-v2 (pls review)
owen_sre: ping about retention policy: do we want 90d for full traces or 30d by default with opt-in for 90d? ops cost impact matters.
laura_pm: decision: default 30d, add per-team 90d opt-in. samir, does that work with current storage plan?
samir_eng: yes — storage adapter supports tiered retention. I'll add server-side TTL + compaction job. ETA for server change: EOD tomorrow if no blocking DB schema changes.
jia_obs: UI needs a field on traces for sampled_flag to show partial traces. samir — do you expose that in ingestion, or should we infer?
samir_eng: I'll emit sampled_flag in the trace header. Example ingest snippet:
```
POST /ingest
{
  "trace_id": "...",
  "spans": [...],
  "sampled_flag": true
}
```
laura_pm: great. owen — can SRE own the canary + rollback playbook for retention flip?
owen_sre: yes. I'll draft runbook. canary plan: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with 30m windows and SLA checks. Will need a feature-flag key from platform.
laura_pm: feature flag key: obs.trace.retention.v2 — product already created it in FF dashboard.
jia_obs: dashboard tasks: (1) new trace timeline view (2) error analysis quick filter (3) retention badge per-tenant. I put mocks in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/trace-ui
samir_eng: small ask — can we get a list of tenants that want 90d by friday so I can pre-allocate storage? maybe marketing / acct team can provide.
laura_pm: cc @owen_sre — customer success will email the opt-ins. I'll collect and post here.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: ingestion-service v2 -> staging in 30m; canary gate: tests.pass && smoke.ok
samir_eng: heads-up — need review on PR #412 (ingest: retention + sampled_flag). tagging @jia_obs for the sampled_flag contract.
jia_obs: reviewing now. quick note — prefer boolean "sampled" name instead of sampled_flag for consistency with existing fields.
samir_eng: ok I'll rename to `sampled` in PR.
owen_sre: infra dependency: we need new index template in ES cluster to avoid mapping conflicts. paging @infra on that but timeline looks doable.
laura_pm: blockers list so far: (1) infra index template (2) PR review #412 (3) SRE runbook feedback. owners: infra -> owen_sre, PR review -> jia_obs + samir_eng, runbook -> owen_sre.
samir_eng: tentative rollout timeline: staging deploy tonight, canary tomorrow morning, full next Tue. I'll update the release note.
jia_obs: will wire up dashboard panels after staging is green. small request: add a sample_field `error_count` to spans for the error analysis view.
samir_eng: I can add error_count if you confirm semantics (count of errors in span).
jia_obs: yes — count of error events; 0 by default.
laura_pm: thanks. can everyone drop a one-line confirmation they can meet the timeline? trying to freeze milestone by EOD.
samir_eng: confirmed — can hit timeline barring infra index.
jia_obs: confirmed — will finish dashboard after staging pass.
owen_sre: confirmed — infra template PR in progress, runbook draft up in 1 hour.
laura_pm: perfect. I'll open a follow-up thread for the customer opt-in list and post the final milestone doc. Thanks all :thumbsup:
